owner_direction.scope: Implement only optional, bounded components whose dependencies and rollback remain local; keep comparisons evidence-calibrated and preserve unknown status where paired outcomes are absent.

does_not_implement: OpenShell installation, sandboxing, kernel rules, syscall monitoring, or policy enforcement
Inheritance resolution, wildcard expansion, path containment, host reachability, or effective-permission calculation
Snapshot authentication, permission grant, approval, or external action
implementation_scope.claim_ceiling: Exact string-set differences between two matching caller-supplied declarations only.

source_constraints: Workbench PR #86 marks TR26-05 as a recorded candidate, NOT_EXECUTED, and permits only optional isolated no-secret permission-policy tests without live access changes.
This implementation compares synthetic or caller-provided declarations and does not reproduce OpenShell behavior or establish a concrete security outcome.
The planner route is proposal-only, default-off, and does not invoke the candidate or apply a policy.
